title: Biosurfactant-driven desorption and remediation of heavy oil contaminated soils underpinned by molecular simulations and microbial dynamics
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,16316-16328
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09479H, Paper
Open Access

Qi Xiu, Honglin He, Zhenghui Liu, Xuan Ou, Yifei Meng, Kangbo Zhao, Qian Yang, Xinrui Zhang, Yahan Hou, Shun Yao, Peike Gao, Wenjie Xia
This study integrates molecular dynamics simulations and bench-scale experiments to investigate the adsorption and desorption behaviors of heavy oil on five mineral substrates: SiO2, kaolinite, muscovite, and Ca2+-/Na+-montmorillonite.
